ordered that the collection of tolls at the Sigma Toll Bridge
be terminated.
This Order shall take effect upon receipt of copy hereof
by the Provincial Treasurer of Capiz.
Done in the City of Manila, this 22nd day of October,
in the year of Our Lord, nineteen hundred and fifty-five,
and of the Independence of the Philippines, the tenth.
RAMON MAGSAYSAY
President of the Philimpines
By thé President:
FRED RUIz CASTRO
Executive Secretary
